name: atlas-of-physics
description: An interactive 3D textbook for AP Physics 1 and AP Physics C

scripts.check: for c in kinematics newton circular energy momentum oscillations rotation fluids electrostatics gauss potential capacitors circuits magnetism induction; do node $c/checks.mjs > /dev/null || { echo FAIL $c; exit 1; }; done; node equations/check.mjs
